get.description: Hostile operationId (quote + backslash). Deliberately parameterless with no request body, so NeedsFixture is false and the operationId reaches the renderer without the fixture-filename validation gate. Exercises RequireFixture(...), [Description(...)] and the synthesized schema key.

Hostile literal path text (quote + backslash), clean operationId. Deliberately parameterless with no request body, so NeedsFixture is false and does not gate on this operation's operationId at all. Exercises InTestUrl.Build("...").

Hostile optional query parameter name (quote + backslash), clean operationId. The query parameter is optional with no example or default, so it never gets a fixture-sentinelled value and NeedsFixture stays false even though the parameter name itself is hostile. Exercises FixtureQueryParameters(...).

Hostile operationId (embedded LF + CR). Deliberately parameterless with no request body, so NeedsFixture is false. Proves CSharpLiteral.Escape's full C# grammar set — not just quote and backslash — through a real compile.
